name: novel-chapters
description: Draft or revise one assigned chapter from scene plans, current canon, causal context, and the narrative contract.
procedure: Read the relevant chapters, scene plans, character notes, and author instructions.
Draft or revise within the requested scope, respecting causal order, voice, and continuity.
Use createChapter or createScene for new prose and exact edits to update existing prose.
Read back the result and update the planning doc with progress and unresolved issues.
Choose the next step from the author's goal and current project state; keep progress in project docs and verify persisted tool results.
